# AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition 26.10.1 Driver Release Notes

**Article Number:** RN-RAD-WIN-26-10-1

**Last Updated**: October 20th, 2026.

## Highlights

* **New Features**

  + AMD FSR Upscaling 4.1 support for:
    - AMD Radeon™ RX 6000 Series Graphics products
    - AMD Ryzen™ AI Max 300 Series processors
    - AMD Ryzen™ AI Max 400 Series processors
    - AMD Ryzen™ AI 9 300 Series processors
    - AMD Ryzen™ AI 9 400 Series processors
* **New Game Support**
  + Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4
  + STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™
  + FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
  + The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered
* **Fixed Issues**
  + Stuttering may be observed while playing the Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 on Radeon™ RX 6000 series graphics products and above.

## Known Issues

* Intermittent application crash or driver timeout may be observed while playing Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced on Radeon™ RX 7000 series graphics products.
* Intermittent driver timeout may be observed while playing War Thunder on Radeon™ RX 5000 series graphics products. Users experiencing this issue are recommended to use AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition 26.9.1.
* Intermittent system shutdown may be observed while playing Valor Mortis on Radeon™ RX 7600 series graphics products.
* Intermittent driver timeout may be observed while playing Valor Mortis on Radeon™ RX 7000 series graphics products.
* Intermittent system shutdown may be observed while playing FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE on Ryzen™ AI MAX PRO 400 Series processors.
* Intermittent application hang may be observed while playing Death Stranding 2: On the Beach with AMD FSR enabled on Radeon™ RX 9000 series graphics products. Users experiencing this issue are recommended to disable AMD FSR.
* Intermittent application crash or driver timeout may be observed while playing Cyberpunk 2077 with AMD FSR Upscaling, AMD Radeon™ Anti-Lag and in-game frame generation enabled during video playback on a secondary display on some Radeon™ RX 9000 series graphics products. Users experiencing this issue are recommended to disable in-game frame generation.
* Black screen may be observed when launching Fallout 76 on Ryzen™ AI Max PRO 400 Series processors.
* Intermittent application crash or driver timeout may be observed in some games when opening or closing other overlays, such as Xbox Game Bar, while the AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition Performance Metrics Overlay is enabled on Radeon™ graphics products. Users experiencing this issue are recommended to temporarily disable the Performance Metrics Overlay before opening or closing other overlays.
* Intermittent system crash or hang may be observed when switching between applications or toggling overlays while playing games with in-game AMD FSR Frame Generation enabled on Radeon™ RX 9000 series graphics products. Users experiencing this issue are recommended to enable V-Sync in game settings.
* Failure to install may be observed while installing AI Bundle components in some regions with limited access to HuggingFace and GitHub.
* AMD Smart Access Memory may become disabled after driver installation on Windows® 10 systems.

## Additional Information

* When downgrading to a previous version of AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition, it is recommended to use the [AMD Cleanup Utility](https://www.amd.com/en/resources/support-articles/faqs/GPU-601.html).

## ​​​​AMD Processors with Radeon Graphics Product Compatibility

#### Important Note for Laptop and All-In-One (AIO) PCs

AMD recommends OEM-provided drivers which are customized and validated for their system-specific features and optimizations.  
   
 If you experience issues using the AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition driver package downloaded from AMD.com, please install the OEM-provided drivers for full support and compatibility.  
   
 AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition does not include support for handheld gaming devices.  Users should check with the OEM for device specific drivers.

| DESKTOP | MOBILE |
| --- | --- |
| AMD Ryzen™ Processors with Radeon™ Graphics | AMD Ryzen™ AI Series Processors with Radeon™ Graphics |
| AMD Ryzen™ PRO Processors | AMD Ryzen™ Processors with Radeon™ Graphics |
| AMD Athlon™ Processors with Radeon™ Graphics | AMD Ryzen™ PRO Processors |
| AMD Athlon™ PRO Processors | AMD Athlon™ Processors with Radeon™ Graphics |
|  | AMD Athlon™ PRO Processors |

## Compatible Operating Systems

AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition 26.10.1 is designed to support the following Microsoft® Windows® platforms. Operating System support may vary depending on your specific AMD Radeon product.

* Windows® 11 version 21H2 and later
* Windows® 10 64-bit version 21H2 and later

* AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition 26.10.1 Driver Version 26.20.15.07 for Windows® 10 and Windows® 11 (Windows Driver Store Version 32.0.32015.7029).
* AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition 26.10.1 Driver Version 25.10.45.16 for Windows® 10 and Windows® 11 (Windows Driver Store Version 32.0.21045.16010).
